name: codexdata
description: CodexData — independent mirror of the official OpenAI Codex model catalog (snapshots + change feed) plus curated third-party model profiles for the Codex client, served as static JSON from Cloudflare Workers. Not affiliated with OpenAI.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/build-compat.mjs --check && node scripts/build-ui.mjs --check && node --test scripts/hooks.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm validate && pnpm test
